description: nextbike Niederösterreich is a shared-mobility system listed in the GBFS registry used by Mobility Database. Its listed geographic coverage is Austria, country code AT. The discovery metadata advertise station descriptions, station availability, available-vehicle status. The JSON auto-discovery endpoint links to the system's published components. Station and vehicle data were not downloaded, and current operation or completeness is not established by a registry listing. The resource can provide shared-mobility supply inputs for transport accessibility, network and capacity studies when the relevant components are available.
